[EN] Serve Me and Live Forever
[ES] Sírveme y vive para siempre
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] May Kaia's wrath be in your hands.
[ES] Que la ira de Kaia esté en tus manos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Soon, Kaia will welcome you home.
[ES] Pronto, Kaia te dará la bienvenida a casa.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Soultrap Shard
[ES] Esquirla de trampa de almas
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Eliminate tower generals, general's escorts, tower decurions, and ebon zombies in the Ebon Tower. [You must select Ebon Tower (Solo) from the {@LinkCreature:251#1501#Teleportal} to advance this quest.]
[ES] Elimina a los generales de la torre, escoltas de generales, decuriones de la torre y zombis de ébano en Ebon Tower. [Debes seleccionar Ebon Tower (Solo) en el {@LinkCreature:251#1501#Teleportal} para avanzar en esta misión.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring the soultrap shards to Savinu in the cave near the Ebon Tower.
[ES] Lleva las esquirlas de trampa de almas a Savinu en la cueva cerca de Ebon Tower.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'd want the same."
[ES] "Yo querría lo mismo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
